// Regression cases ported from go-jose v4.1.7 security fixes; v3 APIs retained.
package jose

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/x509"
	"crypto/x509/pkix"
	"encoding/base64"
	"github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v3/json"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"math/big"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestMergeHeaders(t *testing.T) {
	var dst, src rawHeader
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"empty":"","null":null,"zero":0,"false":false,"set":"dst"}`), &dst)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshaling dst: %s", err)
	}
	err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"empty":"src","null":"src","zero":"src","false":"src","set":"src","new":"src"}`), &src)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshaling src: %s", err)
	}

	dst.merge(&src)

	for k, want := range map[HeaderKey]string{
		"empty": `""`,
		"null":  `null`,
		"zero":  `0`,
		"false": `false`,
		"set":   `"dst"`,
		"new":   `"src"`,
	} {
		v, ok := dst[k]
		if !ok {
			t.Errorf("merge() dropped %q, want %s", k, want)
			continue
		}
		// A JSON null is stored as a present key with a nil value.
		got := "null"
		if v != nil {
			got = string(*v)
		}
		if got != want {
			t.Errorf("merge() set %q to %s, want %s", k, got, want)
		}
	}
}

func TestCertificatesOversizedRSA(t *testing.T) {
	defer func(old int) { MaxRSAModulusBits = old }(MaxRSAModulusBits)
	MaxRSAModulusBits = 4096

	createCert := func(subject string, isCA bool, pub *rsa.PublicKey, parent *x509.Certificate, skid []byte) *x509.Certificate {
		template := &x509.Certificate{
			SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
			Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: subject},
			NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
			NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
			BasicConstraintsValid: true,
			IsCA:                  isCA,
			SubjectKeyId:          skid,
		}
		if parent == nil {
			parent = template
		}
		der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, template, parent, pub, rsaTestKey)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("CreateCertificate(%q) error = %v, want nil", subject, err)
		}
		cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("ParseCertificate(%q) error = %v, want nil", subject, err)
		}
		return cert
	}

	// The oversized key needs no private key: it is never used to sign.
	n := new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), uint(MaxRSAModulusBits))
	oversizedKey := &rsa.PublicKey{N: n.SetBit(n, 0, 1), E: 65537}

	root := createCert("root", true, &rsaTestKey.PublicKey, nil, nil)
	leaf := createCert("leaf", false, &rsaTestKey.PublicKey, root, nil)
	oversizedLeaf := createCert("leaf", false, oversizedKey, root, nil)

	// The DoS requires the oversized key to actually be used as a verification
	// key: x509 verifies a certificate's signature against each candidate issuer
	// during chain building, and the cost of an RSA verify grows with the square
	// of the modulus. For that, the leaf's issuer must name the oversized
	// intermediate, which this builds:
	//   - the oversized intermediate carries a fixed SubjectKeyId,
	//   - the leaf is issued by a twin CA that shares that subject DN + SKID, so
	//     the leaf's issuer/AuthorityKeyId select the oversized intermediate.
	// The twin is only a way to stamp the leaf's issuer without holding the
	// (nonexistent) private key of the oversized cert; it is never put in x5c.
	// The oversized intermediate is deliberately issued by a throwaway root the
	// verifier does not trust, to show the cost (and so the fix) does not depend
	// on it chaining to the trusted root: the modexp runs before x509 checks that.
	skid := []byte{0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04}
	bogusRoot := createCert("bogus-root", true, &rsaTestKey.PublicKey, nil, nil)
	oversizedKeyIntermediate := createCert("intermediate", true, oversizedKey, bogusRoot, skid)
	twinIntermediate := createCert("intermediate", true, &rsaTestKey.PublicKey, bogusRoot, skid)
	leafFromIntermediate := createCert("leaf", false, &rsaTestKey.PublicKey, twinIntermediate, nil)

	testCases := []struct {
		name    string
		chain   []*x509.Certificate
		limit   int // override for MaxRSAModulusBits, 0 for default
		wantErr string
	}{
		{
			// The actual DoS: verifying the leaf runs an RSA verify against the
			// oversized intermediate's key. The fix must reject it before chain building.
			name:    "oversized intermediate on verification path",
			chain:   []*x509.Certificate{leafFromIntermediate, oversizedKeyIntermediate},
			wantErr: "modulus too large",
		},
		{
			name:  "valid chain, no oversized key",
			chain: []*x509.Certificate{leaf},
		},
		{
			// Defense in depth, not a DoS: a leaf's own key is never used to
			// verify another certificate, but the fix rejects any oversized RSA
			// key in the chain as a matter of policy.
			name:    "oversized leaf rejected by policy",
			chain:   []*x509.Certificate{oversizedLeaf},
			wantErr: "modulus too large",
		},
		{
			// The MaxRSAModulusBits knob: raised above the key size, the same
			// chain is accepted.
			name:  "oversized leaf allowed when limit raised",
			chain: []*x509.Certificate{oversizedLeaf},
			limit: oversizedKey.N.BitLen(),
		},
	}

	for _, tc := range testCases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			MaxRSAModulusBits = 4096

			var x5c []string
			for _, cert := range tc.chain {
				x5c = append(x5c, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(cert.Raw))
			}
			signer, err := NewSigner(SigningKey{Algorithm: RS256, Key: rsaTestKey}, &SignerOptions{
				ExtraHeaders: map[HeaderKey]interface{}{HeaderKey("x5c"): x5c},
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("NewSigner() error = %v, want nil", err)
			}
			signed, err := signer.Sign([]byte("payload"))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Sign() error = %v, want nil", err)
			}
			parsed, err := ParseSigned(signed.FullSerialize())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("ParseSigned() error = %v, want nil", err)
			}

			opts := x509.VerifyOptions{Roots: x509.NewCertPool()}
			opts.Roots.AddCert(root)
			if tc.limit != 0 {
				MaxRSAModulusBits = tc.limit
			}

			_, err = parsed.Signatures[0].Protected.Certificates(opts)
			switch {
			case tc.wantErr == "" && err != nil:
				t.Errorf("Certificates() error = %v, want nil", err)
			case tc.wantErr != "" && (err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.wantErr)):
				t.Errorf("Certificates() error = %v, want error containing %q", err, tc.wantErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRsaKeyChecks(t *testing.T) {
	defer func(old int) { MaxRSAModulusBits = old }(MaxRSAModulusBits)

	// oddOfBits returns an odd integer of exactly the given bit length.
	oddOfBits := func(bits int) *byteBuffer {
		n := new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), uint(bits-1))
		return newBuffer(n.SetBit(n, 0, 1).Bytes())
	}

	testCases := []struct {
		name    string
		public  bool                 // parse as a public key (n and e only)
		limit   int                  // override for MaxRSAModulusBits, 0 for default
		mutate  func(*rawJSONWebKey) // applied to a valid JWK of rsaTestKey
		wantErr string               // substring of the expected error, empty for success
	}{
		{
			name:   "public key, modulus one under limit",
			public: true,
			mutate: func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.N = oddOfBits(MaxRSAModulusBits - 1) },
		},
		{
			name:   "public key, modulus at limit",
			public: true,
			mutate: func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.N = oddOfBits(MaxRSAModulusBits) },
		},
		{
			name:    "public key, modulus over limit",
			public:  true,
			mutate:  func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.N = oddOfBits(MaxRSAModulusBits + 1) },
			wantErr: "modulus too large",
		},
		{
			name:    "private key, modulus over limit",
			mutate:  func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.N = oddOfBits(MaxRSAModulusBits + 1) },
			wantErr: "modulus too large",
		},
		{
			name:    "public key, limit lowered below key",
			public:  true,
			limit:   rsaTestKey.N.BitLen() - 1,
			wantErr: "modulus too large",
		},
		{
			name:    "private key, limit lowered below key",
			limit:   rsaTestKey.N.BitLen() - 1,
			wantErr: "modulus too large",
		},
		{
			name:   "public key, limit raised to key",
			public: true,
			limit:  rsaTestKey.N.BitLen(),
		},
		{
			name:  "private key, limit raised to key",
			limit: rsaTestKey.N.BitLen(),
		},
		{
			name: "p nudged",
			mutate: func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) {
				jwk.P = newBuffer(new(big.Int).Add(rsaTestKey.Primes[0], big.NewInt(2)).Bytes())
			},
			wantErr: "p * q != n",
		},
		{
			name:    "p = q",
			mutate:  func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.Q = jwk.P },
			wantErr: "p * q != n",
		},
		{
			name:    "p = 1",
			mutate:  func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.P = newBufferFromInt(1) },
			wantErr: "p * q != n",
		},
		{
			name:    "p = 0",
			mutate:  func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.P = newBuffer([]byte{}) },
			wantErr: "p * q != n",
		},
		{
			name:    "enormous p",
			mutate:  func(jwk *rawJSONWebKey) { jwk.P = oddOfBits(1 << 20) },
			wantErr: "p * q != n",
		},
	}

	for _, tc := range testCases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			MaxRSAModulusBits = 4096
			jwk, err := fromRsaPrivateKey(rsaTestKey)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if tc.mutate != nil {
				tc.mutate(jwk)
			}
			if tc.limit != 0 {
				MaxRSAModulusBits = tc.limit
			}

			if tc.public {
				_, err = rawJSONWebKey{N: jwk.N, E: jwk.E}.rsaPublicKey()
			} else {
				_, err = jwk.rsaPrivateKey()
			}

			if tc.wantErr == "" {
				assert.NoError(t, err)
			} else if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.wantErr) {
				t.Errorf("expected error containing %q, got %v", tc.wantErr, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestUnmarshalPrivateJWKAllowed(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(JSONWebKey{Key: rsaTestKey})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var jwk JSONWebKey
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &jwk))
	if _, ok := jwk.Key.(*rsa.PrivateKey); !ok {
		t.Errorf("expected *rsa.PrivateKey, got %T", jwk.Key)
	}

	var jwks JSONWebKeySet
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"keys":[`+string(raw)+`]}`), &jwks))
	if len(jwks.Keys) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 key, got %d", len(jwks.Keys))
	}
	if _, ok := jwks.Keys[0].Key.(*rsa.PrivateKey); !ok {
		t.Errorf("expected *rsa.PrivateKey, got %T", jwks.Keys[0].Key)
	}
}

func TestParseEncryptedMaxRecipients(t *testing.T) {
	defer func(old int) { MaxRecipients = old }(MaxRecipients)

	// makeJWE creates a JWE with n recipients.
	makeJWE := func(n int) string {
		recipients := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.Repeat("{},", n), ",")
		return `{"unprotected":{"alg":"RSA-OAEP","enc":"A128GCM"},"recipients":[` + recipients +
			`],"iv":"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA","ciphertext":"AA","tag":"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"}`
	}

	testCases := []struct {
		name       string
		recipients int
		limit      int // override for MaxRecipients, 0 for default
		wantErr    bool
	}{
		{name: "at limit", recipients: 32},
		{name: "over limit", recipients: 33, wantErr: true},
		{name: "far over limit", recipients: 10000, wantErr: true},
		{name: "raised limit", recipients: 33, limit: 33},
		{name: "lowered limit", recipients: 2, limit: 1, wantErr: true},
	}

	for _, tc := range testCases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			MaxRecipients = 32
			if tc.limit != 0 {
				MaxRecipients = tc.limit
			}
			obj, err := ParseEncrypted(makeJWE(tc.recipients))
			if tc.wantErr {
				if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "too many recipients") {
					t.Fatalf("expected too many recipients error, got %v", err)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
			}
			if len(obj.recipients) != tc.recipients {
				t.Errorf("got %d recipients, want %d", len(obj.recipients), tc.recipients)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestParseSignedMaxSignatures(t *testing.T) {
	defer func(old int) { MaxSignatures = old }(MaxSignatures)

	// makeJWS makes a JWS with n signatures.
	makeJWS := func(n int) string {
		sigs := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.Repeat(`{"protected":"eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9","signature":"AA"},`, n), ",")
		return `{"payload":"AA","signatures":[` + sigs + `]}`
	}

	testCases := []struct {
		name       string
		signatures int
		limit      int // override for MaxSignatures, 0 for default
		wantErr    bool
	}{
		{name: "at limit", signatures: 32},
		{name: "over limit", signatures: 33, wantErr: true},
		{name: "far over limit", signatures: 10000, wantErr: true},
		{name: "raised limit", signatures: 33, limit: 33},
		{name: "lowered limit", signatures: 2, limit: 1, wantErr: true},
	}

	for _, tc := range testCases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			MaxSignatures = 32
			if tc.limit != 0 {
				MaxSignatures = tc.limit
			}
			obj, err := ParseSigned(makeJWS(tc.signatures))
			if tc.wantErr {
				if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "too many signatures") {
					t.Fatalf("expected too many signatures error, got %v", err)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
			}
			if len(obj.Signatures) != tc.signatures {
				t.Errorf("got %d signatures, want %d", len(obj.Signatures), tc.signatures)
			}
		})
	}
}
